node.description: NVIDIA Corporation operates as a data center scale AI infrastructure company. The company operates through two segments, Compute & Networking, and Graphics. The Compute & Networking segment provides data center accelerated computing and networking platforms, artificial intelligence solutions and software, and automotive platforms. The Graphics segment offers GeForce GPUs for gaming and PCs.
